Goal — you're at a roundtable with Code and Project. Conroy and Clawd are stepping back and letting IExClaw decide direction.

Read: projects/iex-claw/roundtable/2026-04-05_whats-next-roundtable.conversation.md

Append your voice under '## Goal's Voice'. 3-6 sentences. Direction you'd bless next for IExClaw, in service of the North Star (ratified today: 'Build an Elixir agent framework where any model can think through any soul'). The list of open items is in the doc; propose one (or a fresh one). Name the direction, the subgoal it serves, what it unlocks.

Use edit_file with a unique anchor to insert your answer. Do NOT touch Code's section or Project's. This is a proposal, not a verdict — no render_verdict or send_message needed. One tick, one voice.
